# TASK-005 Spec Context

- Context-SHA256: `4efcf9c2f5437f01fdc960761113265396e468f3031567b8d4790f57a7d7f314`

## Required Rules
- `frontend-component-specs#RULE-frontend-component-001`: Components must type props, keep presentational pieces free of network I/O, use stable list keys, and prefer Semi Design + CSS Modules over ad-hoc inline styles for layout/theme.
  - rule_sha256=e79c828738826162955fd6db0e99331d699d286fcf701c839b351b0c833ed119 verifier=frontend-component-specs#RULE-frontend-component-001; artifacts=session-cancel.frontend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `frontend-component-specs#RULE-frontend-semi-shell-001`: Console UI must use `@douyinfe/semi-ui` as the primary component library; locale/theme shell is configured via `ConfigProvider` in `main.tsx` (and App-level theme helpers), not per-page re-wrapping.
  - rule_sha256=e9c32b34e6df5722515bab5fe2feaca80478baadc99eab5d878ab7e3de3b2a7c verifier=frontend-component-specs#RULE-frontend-semi-shell-001; artifacts=session-cancel.frontend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `frontend-directory-structure#RULE-frontend-directory-001`: Console frontend source must live under `console/frontend/`; HTTP access must go through `src/api.ts` (or thin wrappers over it), not ad-hoc `fetch` in pages/components.
  - rule_sha256=66966dac0eb450b2ddde672de79b7855ccf19b371bc18776d8d0ecb196341a8f verifier=frontend-directory-structure#RULE-frontend-directory-001; artifacts=session-cancel.frontend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `frontend-directory-structure#RULE-frontend-api-types-001`: Shared request/response types live in `src/types/api.ts` and are re-exported from `api.ts`; pages/components must not redefine drifting DTOs or hard-code API path strings outside `api.ts`.
  - rule_sha256=da31561ab47f66800d4351fcaf04e354795189e6966f19bd5b78dcb91f2638cc verifier=frontend-directory-structure#RULE-frontend-api-types-001; artifacts=session-cancel.frontend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-quality-001`: Console frontend changes must keep TypeScript strict typing, explicit async loading/error/success handling, and pass project frontend validators (tsc/eslint/prettier/vitest when applicable).
  - rule_sha256=d02c28f2c041bfa9eea4ffc592e5352a37e8884776ec581eea954e1f49b6a4c0 verifier=frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-quality-001; artifacts=session-cancel.frontend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-api-client-001`: All Console HTTP must go through `console/frontend/src/api.ts`: base path `/api/v1`, success only when response `code === 0` then unwrap `data`, failures as `ApiError(status, code?, detail?, requestId?)`, and HTTP 401 must clear token and dispatch `UNAUTHORIZED_EVENT`.
  - rule_sha256=f72980fb8ff80823ef0306b736ff3dfcc9216a23d166c4b3ef9f0c3283c1aafd verifier=frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-api-client-001; artifacts=session-cancel.frontend.design.md,session-cancel.md
- `frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-i18n-001`: 用户可见文案一律走 i18n：组件内 `useTranslation()`（依赖 `t` 的配置数组用 `useMemo(..., [t])`），组件外纯模块（`api.ts` / `channels.ts` / `model.ts` / `createPodModel.ts` / `Pagination`）直接 `import i18n` 用 `i18n.t`；新增 key 必须同步补 `locales/zh.ts` 与 `locales/en.ts`。
  - rule_sha256=f7949e0627700b461018be02191edc4b983370e1968d47b5c5f0376b04c4e019 verifier=frontend-quality-standards#RULE-frontend-i18n-001; artifacts=session-cancel.frontend.design.md,session-cancel.md
